card.name: Words just before 'additive' or 'combined'
card.fires_on: Words where the text is about to say two things add up or are combined, such as 'less than' before 'additive', 'at least' before 'additive', or 'and the Odyssey' before 'combined'. It also fires on some other mid-word or linking spots in drug-combination text.

modes.label: Before 'additive'
modes.description: Comparison words that lead into the word additive when describing combined drug effects.
modes.example: but the effects of the two drugs are less<< than>> additive.

modes.label: Sum of two things
modes.description: The last word of a pair whose total is about to be stated, as in 'combined'.
modes.example: six times the size of the Iliad and the<< Odyssey>> combined.
